meta.source: Nós no Limiar Identity v0.1 (3 out 2026), which mirrors limiar-app/src/theme at commit 66bf059. Origin of each colour (spec §18, measured from the approved mockup, derived, added) is kept in its usage note. Light only; dark mode is still open.

tokens.name: offWhite
tokens.usage: Ground: app background (spec §18). Also the only light logo ink and the text colour on wine.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Ground: chips and featured cards (spec §18). Only ink text on sand: stone on sand is 4.25:1, ash 3.54:1, both never.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Tint: highlighted tile, badges, list-row and checklist icon discs (measured). Ink on rose 11.58:1.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Divider lines (derived). Decorative only, not a control border.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input outline (chosen for 3:1 on paper; measures 3.55:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text: headlines and primary text (spec §18). 13.99:1 on offWhite. The dark logo ink.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Text: captions, inactive tabs (darkened for 4.5:1; 4.97:1 on offWhite).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Dark chip ground (measured). offWhite on charcoal 7.62:1.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: THE action colour: primary buttons, active tab, selected states, focus ring (measured from the mockup's buttons). Never decoration. offWhite on wine 10.71:1.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Olá, que bom ter você aqui!

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Section header (with a Ver todos → link).

styles.name: cardTitle
styles.sample: Como criar hábitos que fazem bem
styles.usage: Card and list-row titles; also the button label style.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Desenhar a planta da casa da infância e marcar três lugares que guardam lembranças boas ou curiosas.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and activity steps. stone on paper.

styles.name: bodySmall
styles.sample: Escolher uma rua ou praça pouco conhecida e caminhar, respeitando mobilidade e segurança.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, list-row subtitles. ash on offWhite.

styles.name: tabLabel
styles.usage: Tab bar labels; 600 and wine when active.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Title to its content; gutter below 360-pt width.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; icon button size.
